item.title: Northern Light (5)
item.description: DALFSEN – I observed the Northern Light tonight here in Dalfsen. The pictures are taken between 22:11-22:19. I thought it would be fun to share this unique observation with others. I’m from Norway and see the Northern Lights every winter, but I never thought I would see it here in the Netherlands.
